tool.name: ParaFEM Thermal BC Generator
tool.description: Generate boundary condition and control files for steady-state thermal analysis (p123)

param.name: mesh_d
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: ParaFEM .d file from mesh generator or mesh import tool

param.name: zone_config
param.label: BC Configuration (JSON)
param.help: In 'zone' mode: JSON array of zones with axis_min, axis_max (0-1), and temperature. In 'nset' mode: JSON array with nset_name and temperature.

param.name: nset_file
param.label: Node sets (.nset)
param.help: Input .nset file from ParaFEM Mesh Import tool

tool.help:
Generates ParaFEM boundary condition files for steady-state thermal analysis (p123).
Reads the mesh .d file, identifies boundary nodes, and assigns fixed temperatures to nodes falling within user-defined heater zones along the specified axis.
Zone configuration is a JSON array where each zone specifies: - axis_min, axis_max: normalized position (0.0 = mesh start, 1.0 = mesh end) - temperature: prescribed temperature in Kelvin
Nodes on boundary surfaces within a zone get Dirichlet BCs (fixed temperature). All other boundary nodes are left free (insulated, zero-flux natural BC).
Output files: - .dat: solver control parameters for p123 - .bnd: restrained nodes (only heated zone nodes) - .fix: fixed freedom values (node, sense=1, temperature) - .d: pass-through of the input mesh file
